name: Emissive Volume Bootstrapping
definition: An optimization initialization strategy to overcome local minima in the loss landscape of volumetric scattering coefficients. It involves first optimizing a simplified, nonphysical model consisting of purely emissive and absorbing volumes, then using the resulting densities to initialize the scattering volume optimization.
summary: Emissive Volume Bootstrapping initializes scattering volumes by first optimizing a simplified emissive model to decouple density estimation, overcoming local minima that hinder direct optimization.
